ITEM 1 | Single wedge-shaped slice on the upper right edge of a white square plate, roughly 8 cm long and 5 cm wide at its widest; pale cream-white interior with a golden-tan top crust dotted with dark brown charred spots, slightly puffed and bubbly with a glossy, moist-looking surface, holding its shape with a flat cut edge, sitting on the plate rim | 110

ITEM 2 | Small scattered crumbs of a pale yellow-green granular material on the white tablecloth just left of the plate, each crumb about 0.5 to 1 cm, dry and matte, not on the plate | 3

ITEM 3 | Small green-yellow fragment at the bottom edge of the plate area, about 1 cm, flattened and slightly wilted with a matte surface, sitting on the glass surface beneath the plate | 2
